title: Composition prerequisites
description: Prerequisites between independent standards authorities. This is not a general-purpose graph and the vocabulary is deliberately specific: an authority REQUIRES another authority to be SATISFIED before its own result may contribute to a composed conclusion. Naming the relation precisely is what keeps this file free of domain reasoning — it says nothing about either subject, only about the order in which conclusions may be relied upon.

dependencies.description: Keyed by the DEPENDENT authority at an exact version. A prerequisite recorded for one release says nothing about any other release of the same pack.

authority.description: The prerequisite authority, at an exact version. Must be a registered adapter.

condition.description: What must hold of the prerequisite. v1 supports one condition: the prerequisite authority must itself be satisfied. Additional conditions would each need their own semantics and their own evidence, so none are invented in advance.

rationale.description: Why this prerequisite belongs to the orchestrator rather than to either pack. A prerequisite that could be enforced inside one of the two packs does not belong here.
